title: Zapping Rocks Unlocks Stimulated Geologic Hydrogen
summary: The article explores a novel method of extracting hydrogen from geological formations by applying electrical stimulation to rocks, potentially unlocking a significant source of clean energy from the Earth itself.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of discovering viable natural hydrogen sources for clean energy production beyond artificial synthesis methods.
why_valuable: Natural geologic hydrogen could provide a nearly carbon-free, domestically-sourced energy carrier that revolutionizes the clean energy landscape.
